sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Fuinjutsu, Stable

system.description:
As a part of the requirements of this jutsu, you must have the Ketsuryugan active and be near a sufficient source of water. You slash both of your wrists and allow the blood to pour into a pool near you, in amounts that seem inhuman. The wounds on your arms heal and the water bubbles and boils, until it erupts into a dragon.

You command the Dragon, and it only listens to you (no action needed). It uses your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC to calculate its attack bonus or save DC.

The Blood Dragon takes its turn immediately after yours and uses the following Statistics;

Blood Dragon

Gargantuan Construct, Unaligned

Armor Class 21

Hit Points 100

Speed 40 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +6 | +11 | CON | +6 | +11 | WIS | +0 | - |

| DEX | +1 | +7 | INT | -5 | - | CHA | -5 | -5 |

Damage Vulnerabilities Earth

Damage Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing

Damage Immunities Fire, Poison

Condition Immunities Bleeding, Bruised, All Mental and Sensory, Paralyzed, Petrified, Envenomed

Senses Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 10

Ineffable Makeup. The Blood Dragon cannot be dispelled by any jutsu of A-Rank or Lower.

Liquid Body. Creatures are able to pass through the body of the Blood Dragon at its summoner's discretion. If a creature ends their turn in your space, they are immediately ejected out of you in a space that can hold them.

Attacks

Multiattack: The Blood Dragon can attack 2 times with its Bite or Hydra Bullet.

Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 3d10 + 6 Cold or Necrotic damage (pick one).

Hydra Bullet: Ranged Weapon Attack: Range (60/120), one creature. Hit: 4d6+6 Cold or Necrotic damage (pick one).

Vicious Vortex: The heads of the dragon converge and form into a gargantuan torrent of water, ripping everything it touches to shreds. The dragon travels to a space within its movement speed, taking a specific path that you designate. Each creature within this path must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 cold or necrotic damage (pick one) and having their movement speed reduced by half until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half as much damage and no further effects on a success.

Blood Ocean: (Recharge 9-10): The Blood Dragon casts Genjutsu: Numbing Blood Spear at B-Rank as if you had cast it twice, at two different locations. These castings cannot trigger their Blood Detonation, effects.
